fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Order.Delete
fields.Description: Delete any Draft or Quoted order, whoever created it (OrderEntityServer.Delete). Parent of MJ.BizApps.Orders.Order.DeleteOwn, so it implies it. Entity permissions still decide whether a role may delete order rows at all; this decides whose. Held by Finance, and by Developer, which keeps every permission. A deal's draft order deleted with its deal is exempt: sales deletes it as the system user after its own deal check. Without this row, no one can delete an order.

fields.Name: MJ.BizApps.Orders.Order.DeleteOwn
fields.Description: Delete a Draft or Quoted order the user created, read from the order's Create entry in MJ: Record Changes. An order with no recorded creator needs MJ.BizApps.Orders.Order.Delete. Held by Account Director.
